Consequence: On a failure, you become Deafened until the end of your next turn (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats) as the voices of the spirits around you encroach on your telepathic inquiry and seek acknowledgement from beyond.

(Primarily Narrative Ability, -1 String)

docs.title: Evasive Tactics - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 3.5 Strings

Prerequisite: A Battlefield Instigator

Maneuver Base (-1.5 Strings) [Narration Required]

Short Rest -> General (+2 Strings)

As a reaction to seeing one of your allies within Close (+1 String), including yourself, being targeted by an attack targeting a Physical Potential, you may expend a Die from your Maneuver Pool to allow the targeted ally to make a Reflex Test to avoid the attack entirely (Utility, +1 String). When making this Test, roll the expended Maneuver Die as if it were a Volatility Die, resolve the Perk, then notify your ally of the resulting value. If the resulting value is higher than any value in the ally’s Volatility Pool or they did not have any Volatility Dice applicable to the Test, then they may use the resulting value instead of their Volatility Pool result (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: We’re Right Behind You - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 3.5 Strings

Prerequisite: A Battlefield Instigator/Summoner

Maneuver Base (-1.5 Base) [Narration Required]

Short Rest -> Spell (+1 String)

On a successful Steel Test, expend a Die from your Maneuver Pool to bolster all allies within Close (AOE, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement). While you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) for the next Scene (+2 Strings), each of the target allies have a Nerve Shield (Armored, +1 String) with a number of Protection Slots equal to a roll of your Maneuver Die (Utility, +1 String).

Consequence: On a failure, you are Physically Vulnerable until the end of your next turn (Major Fallout, -2 Strings).

docs.title: Disarm - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings

Prerequisite: A Battlefield Instigator

Maneuver Base (Short Rest Trait, -1.5 Strings) [Narration Required]

Short Rest -> General (+2 Strings)

As a reaction to hitting a target creature with an attack targeting a Physical Potential, you may expend a Die from your Maneuver Pool to attempt to remove the Armed Condition (Recover Minor Condition, +2 Strings) from the target creature, targeting one item they are holding. Roll your Maneuver Die: add its value to the base damage of your triggering attack (Prime, +1 Enhancement). On a successful Sleight Test (Test Required, -5 Beats), the target creature no longer has the target item equipped, which falls to the ground below them.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Quick Study - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 2.6 Strings

Prerequisite: A Battlefield Instigator

Maneuver Base (Short Rest Trait, -1.5 Strings) [!Narration Required]

Short Rest -> General (+2 Strings)

As a part of activating this Ability, describe one aspect of an adversary that can be learned from or adapted to [!]. If this is a feature that was not yet described and not represented in the adversary’s statblock, you identify a Weak Point (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) and gain 1 Beat (Experience Trigger, +1 String). You may activate this Ability as a reaction to failing on a Test made against an adversary, or as a reaction to a successful Test made by an adversary against you. Creatures can accumulate a number of Weak Points equal to your Tier (Utility, +1 String).

When you activate this ability, expend a Die from your Maneuver Pool. You may take healing in Wit equal to a roll of your Maneuver Die.

While a creature has a Weak Point identified, you or an ally may take a reaction to expend a number of Weak Points to trigger one of the following effects, spending the corresponding number of Weak Points to activate [Weak Points]. Expending a Weak Point means it is removed from the target creature:

  • Gain Advantage when making a Test against this creature [1*]

  • Gain an extra amount of damage to an attack made against this creature equal to XWDV to Instinct, where X is your Tier [2*]

  • The target becomes Vulnerable (P) for the next minute when taking damage in a given Potential, P [3*]

  • When the target ends its movement within Here of you, make an attack and move Close, then recover a Stress in Wit [4*]

(*Narrow Trigger)

docs.title: Life Drain - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Strings

Prerequisite: Channeling

Manifestation Base (General Trait, -1.5 Strings) [Narration Required, Test Required]

Trait -> Action (-1 String -1 Enhancement)

Direct Focus:

On a successful Anchor Test, you may target a creature There (+1.5 Strings). Deal (1 + X)TDV (Initial, Prime, Increase, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) damage to Heart, where X is your Tier (Utility, +1 String). You may then recover a Stress in Nerve (+1 String).

Indirect Flipside [*]:

(Budget: 1.5 Strings)

You attempt to wrestle the spirits’ hunger for vitality by channeling it through your weapon attacks. On a successful Weave Test, during the current Scene (+2 Strings), Tests made to damage targets Here are made with Disadvantage (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String), but on a success, you may also deal 1TDV damage to Heart (+1 String).

Consequence: On a failure, you are Rooted until the end of your next turn (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats) as the spirits you called upon try to feast upon your vital energy instead.

docs.title: Bough Creeper
docs.text:
Cost: 7.1 Strings

Prerequisite: Leshen/Summoner (-2 Strings)

General Surge (4 Strings 1 Enhancement)

You may spend a Seep Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to, during the current Scene (+2 Strings), take on a Cryptid (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) form. While a Cryptid, the following effects apply to you:

  • You may consider any type of Movement as 1 Range category higher (+2 Strings). 

  • You have a Knack called “Lanky Boi” (+2 Strings).

  • You have Disadvantage on Squirm and Hope Tests (-2 Strings).

  • Other cryptids and shadow-entities consider you as a neutral party, unless proven otherwise (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: If a Voice Calls in the Forest
docs.text:
Cost: 8 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Leshy/Control (-2 Strings)

General Action (4 Strings)

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 4 Strings (1 Enhancement))

General -> Spell (-1 String)

Assault the mental faculties of an adversary through your channeled Warp. On a successful Tether (Aura) Test, a target within Far (+2 Strings) becomes Mentally Vulnerable (+3 Strings +1 Enhancement) for the current Scene (+2 Strings). Roll a D20. On a 1, the channeled Warp becomes unstable, causing an eldritch creature to be pulled from a neighboring dimension to a space Close to you (Severe Narrative Fallout, -2 Strings).

Consequence: On a failure, you are Afraid of the target for the next minute (Major Fallout, -2 Strings).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Focus:

You throw your voice or mimic the sound of an adversary’s ally. On a successful Sway Test (-5 Beats), target an adversary within There (+1.5 Strings). The target must make a Read Test or become Disoriented. The first time a target becomes Disoriented, activate one of the following effects:

  • The Disoriented creature moves Near in a direction of your choice*.

  • The Disoriented creature must take a Stress in Instinct or take action on their next turn based on the message you deliver*.

  • If you are not within Line of Sight of the Disoriented creature, they are compelled to investigate the source of the voice.*

(^Interpretable*, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Grasp of the Earth
docs.text:
Cost: 10 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Control/Summoner (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus:

You call upon the spirits of the earth to stop your enemy in their tracks. On a successful Grasp Test, target a point There (+1.5 Strings). All adversaries within Close of that point (Close AOE, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) takes 1TDV in Finesse (Initial Damage, +1 String) and becomes Rooted (AOE Minor Condition, +3 Strings) for the next minute (+2 Strings) or until they make a successful Feat Test (-5 Beats).

Consequence: On a failure, any allies within the area must make a Feat Test or suffer the effects instead (Major Fallout, -2 Strings).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 5 Strings)

You coax the nature around you to grow in a manner helpful to your goal. On a successful Weave Test, you magically enhance the vitality of the flora around you, allowing you to create tools and structures woven by the plants themselves (Interpretable, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement). The next Test you make using the help of the plants is considered to be incremented by 1 Success Level (+5 Beats).

Consequence: On a failure, you are Pushed (Near) away from the growing plants (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats) as the plants seize the opportunity to grow on their own accord.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Forest Spirits’ Wrath
docs.text:
Cost: 4.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Spiritual Prescience (-2 Strings)

General Action (4 Strings)

Direct Focus:

You call upon your ancestors to attack a targeted enemy. On a successful Nerve (Sway) Test, target a creature There (+1.5 Strings). The creature that is targeted takes 1NDV in Wit (Initial Damage, +1 String).

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 2.2 Strings)

You attack an enemy with the antlers of your skull. On a successful Steel Test, target a creature within Here. The targeted creature takes 1D10 in Might (Weapon Damage, +1 String), and becomes Vulnerable (Finesse) (Minor Condition, +1 String) until the beginning of your next turn.

docs.title: Upgrade
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings

Prerequisite: N/A

Base Cost (4 Strings)

Increase the number of uses (+1 String) available to your A Battlefield Instigator Ability by your Tier (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: Crown of Thorns
docs.text:
Cost: 8.6 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Channeling/Control

Manifestation Base (General Trait, -1.5 Strings) [Narration Required]

General -> Spell (-1 String)

Trait -> Action (-1 String -1 Enhancement)

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 4.3 Strings)

Spell -> General (+1 String)

You may create an apparition of one of your spirits within There (+1.5 Strings). This apparition appears to be and acts like a living humanoid (Utility, +1 String) except for their intangibility (Narrative Consequence, -5 Beats). This lasts for the current Scene (+2 Strings) while you Concentrate (-1 String).

Indirect Focus:

On a successful Nerve (Sway) Test, you force a target creature within There (+1.5 Strings) to make an Anchor Test or become Possessed (Aesthetic, +1 Beat); set out a Nerve DV Sequence Die (+2 Strings +1 Enhancement). While Possessed, the target is Petrified (+3 Strings +1 Enhancement) except for movement and actions decided by the spirit that is possessing the target. This spirit cannot cast magick, access the memories of the target, or cause the target to engage in any self-endangering behavior (Narrative Consequence, -5 Beats).

You may expend a use of the Sequence Die to have your spirit take one of the following actions:

  • Activate one of the target’s non-magical Abilities of the spirit’s choice.*

  • Move within There in a direction of the spirit’s choice.**

  • Spend a Nerve Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to activate one of the two options above but control the spirit’s exact choices.*

(^Interpretable, +4 Strings +1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

(Consequence = Test Required, no discount)

docs.title: Echoes of Starlight - Surge
docs.text:
Cost Budget: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Heir to The Weaver (-2 Strings)

Long Rest Surge (1 String 1 Enhancement)

When you activate this Surge, you gain a special temporal perception (GM ruling, +2 Strings) into the many events that have occurred associated with an object you are holding. You may spend a Tether Resistance (-1 Enhancement) to instead expand this perception to all things within Close (Close AOE, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) of you.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Driven - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Driven Base (1 String (1 Enhancement))

Proof of Concept (Minor Goal, +1 String): Every time you finish a magickal engineering project that explores an aspect of The Singularity, you gain new insights into the application of your family’s theory and gain a String.

Hero Complex (Flaw, +2 Strings): Chooses to be selfless to a fault to atone for sins and pain that he blames himself for. Will recklessly throw himself into the fire while neglecting his own desires, wishes, and safety if it means that he can help even a single person. A normal man forcing himself to measure up to the standards and morality of a paragon/hero while not considering anything beyond what their “code” would be.

docs.title: Extra Attack - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tier 2 (-2 Strings)

General Trait (6 Strings, 1 Enhancement)

Once per turn, after you take a weapon or unarmed attack, you may take a reaction and make one additional weapon or unarmed attack.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Enchantment Adept - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings

Prerequisite: Halfcaster/Craftsman (-2 Strings)

Upgrade Base (5 Strings)

Increase your max Enhancement limit per Ability and per Tier (Utility, +1 String) by 1.

docs.title: Tune Up - Ritual
docs.text:
Cost: 9 Strings (3 Enhancements)

Prerequisite: Halfcaster/Tier 2/Craftsman (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Trait (2 Strings, 1 Enhancement)

Your training in Inscription gives you the ability to imbue items you have crafted with magical power, involving materials spent (Material Components, -1 String), appropriate tools used, and time expended (Narrow Trigger, -1 String). Imbuing these items requires you to spend an entire Short Rest’s worth of work, forfeiting any other benefits from a Short Rest in exchange. Whenever you imbue a mundane item with a magical effect with this Ritual, the effect lasts Until Dispelled (+2 Enhancements). If an enchanted item would overlap another in terms of where they are equipped in Equipment Slots, you can only benefit from one enchantment at a time. Switching to benefitting from another enchantment requires a Surge.

This ability allows you to generate Option Abilities (Utility, +1 String) called Enchantments. Each distinct piece of equipment can be applied with 1 Enchantment after meeting the requirements of the ritual defined by this Ability. Though an Enchantment represents the capability of a magical item, it is considered separate from the existence of the physical base item. The effects of an Enchantment can only be activated by a wielder while they possess the piece of equipment (Narrow Trigger, -1 String). Each Option then has a base discount of -1 String.

1st Enhancement (+2 Strings)

2nd Enhancement (+3 Strings)

3rd Enhancement (+5 Strings)

docs.title: Airgeadlámh - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

This magical item replaces a biological component of your physical body. It is considered magical in regards to anti-magic effects (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String). You may apply a second Enchantment on this item as if it were nonmagical (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: Panopticon - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

This item replaces one of your eyes (Narrative Cost, -5 Beats). This item gives you the ability to see Invisible creatures, see into the Ether, see the flow of magic, and see in darkness as shades of grey as if it is well-lit (Interpretable, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement). When you are perceiving in this way, you must Concentrate (-1 Enhancement), otherwise you are Dazed (Major Fallout, -2 Strings). 

This sight is blockable by heavy metals such as lead, starmetal, and tungsten, thus removing the sensory input to the Panopticon.

docs.title: Non-Newtonian Starmetal - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

When creating items using Starmetal (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), the item is capable of shifting its form, altering its functional capabilities based on the assumed shape (Utility, +1 String). This effect manifests either of the two options below:

  • This item counts as a melee weapon that deals 1WDV damage associated with the form.

  • This item grants Advantage on Tests associated with its form. 

(+1 String: Advantage or Initial Damage)

docs.title: Adamantine Coating - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4 String

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

This item has been coated in an unbreakable coating of Adamantine,granting it the Tough property (Minor Condition/GM Ruling, +1 String), and removing the Fragile property (Minor Condition/GM Ruling, +1 String). You may apply a second Enchantment on this item as if it were nonmagical (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: Orphic Whetstone - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

This weapon deals an extra XMDV nonmagical damage to the weapon’s target Potential on a hit (Prime and Increase Damage, +1 String +1 Enhancement) where X is the wielder’s Tier (Utility, +1 String).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Tempered Scale - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

While equipped, this armor piece grants Warded(1) (Major Condition, +4 Strings, +1 Enhancement).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Tempered Soul - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

While equipped, this armor piece grants Fortified(1) (Major Condition, +4 Strings, +1 Enhancement).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Tempered Spear - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

While equipped, this equipment piece grants the Empowered (P) (Minor Condition, +1 String) when making Skill Tests where the equipped item is either adjacent to or directly influencing the Test, where P is a Potential chosen during the enchantment ritual.

docs.title: Prismatic Weave - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up/Enchantment Adept

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

While equipped, this armor piece grants Proof (+3 Strings) to damage originating from one of the four primary Elemental Planes, chosen on Enchantment, and keeps you comfortable in inclement weather/climate conditions (Utility Narrative Weight, +1 String). You may change which of the four Elemental Planes you will be granted Proof to (Utility, +1 String) by taking a Rest Action (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String).

docs.title: Eye of the Forge - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

You have Advantage on Tests made to resist airborne/lightborne ocular effects (Advantage, +1 String) (Utility Narrative Weight, +1 String).

docs.title: Pharmopol Mask - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

You are immune to the specific disease this mask was made for (Everrot)*. You have Advantage on Tests made to resist airborne, breathable effects (Advantage, +1 String). Every time you take off this mask, roll a D20. Ask your GM what happens whenever you roll a 1 (Severe Narrative Fallout, -2 Strings).

(^Narrow Trigger, -1 String)

You may spend 1 Wit Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to activate one of its Amplified modes. Only one mode can be active at a time, and switching between them requires you to spend the Amplification cost again. Once one of the following modes has been activated, it can last until your next Long Rest:

  • You may also use this mask to breathe underwater**.

  • You may use this mask to mimic any voice you’ve heard. On a successful Recall Test, your performance is believable.*

(^Interpretable*, +4 Strings +1 Enhancement)

docs.title: Kaleidoscopic Chamber - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tune Up/Evoker’s Charge

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

Reusing Ability (+1 Enhancement)

When you hit with an attack using this firearm, you activate a random (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String) Option under the Arcane Edge Ability. This is restricted to the Base Mode.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Etheric Ammunition - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

This ranged weapon does not need to be reloaded as long as you have the raw components necessary to craft the ammunition (Utility, +1 String). Doing so expends the raw components (Material Components, -1 String).

docs.title: Drill Shot - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

When you make a ranged attack with this weapon you add, if your target is wearing armor (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), your target may not apply the Stress to their armor’s Protection Slots (Utility, +1 String).

docs.title: Dimensional Pocket - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Base (-1 String)

General Trait (+2 Strings)

The interior of this container is connected to a pocket of the Ether. Items stored in this container are thus stored in the Ether, and are not physically in the bag itself. You can only retrieve an object from the Ether by reaching into the bag and thinking of the object you wish to pull out, which then materializes in your grasp.

If this Enchantment should lose its magic, any of the container’s contents are scattered within Yonder (GM ruling, -1 Enhancement) in the Etheric Plane (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String)

(^Interpretable, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement).

docs.title: Poor Man’s Workshop - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1.1 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Tune Up Option Base (-1.5 Strings)

While you have access to a set of artisans’ or engineers’ tools, you may make an Esoterica Test to magically alter the toolset to become a specific other type of toolset (Utility, +1 String). This toolset is considered magical (Aesthetic, +1 Beat). Any Test made with this toolset is considered to have Advantage (+1 String). If you are attuned to this toolset (as per the Attunement Stat) (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), while you Concentrate, you can magically control this toolset to move on its own and affect objects you can see within a range of There (+1.5 String).

docs.title: Attunement - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 4.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Tune Up

Discipline Pool Base (6 Strings)

You have a number of Attunement Slots equal to your Potency [5] (-1 String, GM ruling). Magical equipment items can be assigned to each of these slots; each slot assignment requires a Rest action (Narrative Consequence, -5 Beats).

docs.title: Artifact Adept - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 9.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Attunement (-2 Strings)

General Trait (5 Strings 1 Enhancement)

When you have an item assigned to one of your Attunement Slots (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you gain the following benefits:

  • If the item is a weapon, any time an effect would cause you to lose the Armed condition, you avoid this part of the effect. Otherwise, if the item is armor, any time an effect would cause you to lose the Armored condition, you avoid this part of the triggering effect.*

  • If an effect would cause the magic item to lose its enchantment, permanently or otherwise, you may choose to Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) and temporarily maintain the item’s enchantment. When you Concentrate on a magical item for the first time, make a Dire Anchor Test (Increase Riskiness x2, -1 String) (Test Required, -5 Beats). On a success, while you Concentrate, you may still benefit from this item’s Enchantment. If you succeed, you may repair your Attunement and remove the need for Concentration, by taking another Rest action with this item. On a failure, the effect succeeds in dispelling your Enchantment and you must undergo the Tune Up ritual again before the item is considered magical again.**

  • You may store attuned items in the Ether. Any handheld item that is not on your person but is within Far range (+2 Strings) can be returned to you in the same way, as long as there is a clear path to you. This includes being able to swap equipped items using a Surge.*

(*Interpretable, +4 Strings +1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Relic Resonance - Ritual
docs.text:
Cost: 4.1 Strings

Prerequisite: Artifact Adept (-2 Strings)

Long Rest Trait (2 Strings 1 Enhancement)

If you take a Rest action at the end of a Long Rest, you may perform a blood ritual (Material Component, -1 String) that binds a set of any number of similar magical items to each other and yourself. To undergo this ritual, you must take a Major Fallout that lasts until you take another Long Rest (Severe Fallout, -4 Strings). Make a Weave Test: on a success this Ability creates a Relic Set (Aesthetic, +1 Beat); on a failure, you take Resistance Drain (-1 Enhancement) for each magical item involved in the ritual.

A Relic Set is considered 1 magical item when assigning it to an Attunement Slot, and can overlap in the same Equipment Slot if narratively relevant**. You may apply one extra Tune Up Option to a Relic Set (called a Relic Enchantment) without interfering with each individual item’s existing magical effects**. This Relic Enchantment is only active while you have each of the items within the Relic Set equipped, and all items’ enchantments are active*. Only you may benefit from the magical effects of a Relic Set, as they are bound to your blood*.

(^Narrow Trigger, -1 String)

(Interpretable, +6 Strings +1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Guile - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Halfcaster

Dexterity Base (1 String, 1 Enhancement)

The Guile Ability allows you to use your Wit Potential instead of your Might Potential when making Tests with melee weapons. This does not apply to any weapon with the Heavy or Unwieldy properties.

1st Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Halfcaster Prerequisite Added (+1 String)

docs.title: Artisan and Dangerous - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 7 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Guile (-2 Strings)

General Trait (5 Strings 1 Enhancement)

You are considered to have the Knack (Proficiency, +2 Strings): “Artisan and Dangerous,” granting you an extra Volatility Die when determining your Volatility Pool while making Tests with an item you made yourself.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Arcane Edge - Surge
docs.text:
Cost: 6.6 Strings (2 Enhancements) 

Prerequisite: Artisan and Dangerous (-2 Strings) 

Spell Surge (3 Strings 1 Enhancement) [Current: +4DV]

On a successful Esoterica Test, until the beginning of your next turn, any melee weapon or unarmed attack you make deals extra damage (Primed to Increase Damage, 1 Enhancement) as your eyes begin to glow with the magic of the Elemental Planes (Aesthetic, +1 Beat). The damage type is determined by a secondary Option Ability. For every new Option purchased for this ability, you deal an additional 1WDV on the triggering attack (Utility, +1 String). Each new Option has a base cost of 2 Strings (determined by +1 for Utility Narrative Weight for damage type, and +1 for damage increase). 

Consequence: On a failure, your next Movement Action is cancelled (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats). 

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

2 Enhancement (+3 Strings)

docs.title: Spring’s Edge - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 5.6 Strings

Arcane Edge Base (2 Strings) [+1DV] [Seep]

You deal damage that channels the fierce winds of the Elemental Plane of Air. Whenever you activate this Option, your weapon is enveloped by a violent gale (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) as you strike your target. On a hit, a target must make a Frame Test or become Pushed (There) (Minor Condition, +1 String) (Range, +1 String) away from you. You may spend a Wit Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to instead cause the target to become Physically Vulnerable (Major Condition, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) when they fail on the Frame Test until the beginning of your next turn.

(*Test Required, -5 Beats)

docs.title: Summer’s Edge - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4.6 Strings

Arcane Edge Base (2 Strings) [+1DV] [Finesse]

You deal damage that channels the ravenous inferno of the Elemental Plane of Fire. Whenever you activate this Option, your weapon alights with scorching heat (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) as you strike your target. If your target is an inanimate flammable object (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may cause it to set aflame (Utility, +1 String). Creatures hit by this effect must stop, drop, and roll a Grace Test or become Muddled(F) (Minor Condition, +1 String) until the end of your next turn. You may spend a Resistance (-1 Enhancement) instead give a target that fails the Grace Test the Bleeding (F) Condition (Major Condition, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) until the beginning of your next turn.

(*Test Required, -5 Beats)

docs.title: Autumn’s Edge - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4.6 Strings

Arcane Edge Base (2 Strings) [+1DV] [Nerve]

You deal damage that channels the violent quakes of the Elemental Plane of Earth. Whenever you activate this Option, your weapon grows jagged crystal shards across its length (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) as you strike your target. On a hit, the target must make a Bear Test or become Rooted (Minor Condition, +1 String) until the end of your next turn. You may spend a Wit Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to instead cause a target that fails their Bear Test to become Pinned (Major Condition, +2 String +1 Enhancement) until the beginning of your next turn.

(*Test Required, -5 Beats)

docs.title: Winter’s Edge - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4.6 Strings

Arcane Edge Base (2 Strings) [+1DV] [Might]

You deal damage that channels the debilitating cold of the Elemental Plane of Water.

Whenever you activate this Option, your weapon exudes an aura of bitter hoarfrost (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) as you strike your target. The creeping ice covers the target’s joints, and they must make a Feat Test (Test Required, -5 Beats) or become Bound (Minor Condition, +1 String) until the end of your next turn. You may spend a Wit Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to instead cause the target to become Slowed (Major Condition, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) when they fail on the Feat Test* until the end of your next turn.

(*Test Required, -5 Beats)

docs.title: Inanimate Vessel
docs.text:
Cost Budget: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Spirit Golem

Trait:

You are Vulnerable against effects that would magically alter your form. Your body consists of mundane and replaceable materials that do not experience fatigue or needs in the same way an organic body would. Your golemic nature grants you benefits including but not limited to:

  • You do not need to eat or drink to sustain life.

  • You do not need to sleep, instead you require 6 hours of being in an inert state, during which you remain conscious and vigilant. Magick, however, can put you to sleep.

  • After a Short Rest, you may regain 1 Mark when spending resources or using a Spell to manually repair your vessel.

  • You are able to spend the entirety of a Long Rest expending materials to recover a lost limb or body part.

  • You may spend a Resistance in Seep to apply this ability in any other interpretable manner.

docs.title: Divine Barrier - Spell
docs.text:
Cost: 6.5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Healer (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings): 

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 3.2 Strings)

Make an Aura Test to conjure a shield of radiance over a Close ally (+1 String). This shield radiates light within Close range (Aesthetic, +1 Beat). When this Spell is first activated, the target creature can recover 1 Might Resistance (+2 Strings). During this scene (+2 Strings), while you maintain concentration (-1 String), this ally is considered to have a Heart Shield equipped (Armored Condition, +1 String) (provides 2 Protection Slots, refreshes when spending a Heart Resistance).

Consequence: On a Failure, you are Cursed for the next minute, or until you take a Surge to make a successful Hope Test. (Major Fallout, -2 Strings)

Indirect Focus:

Test Hope to grant Near allies (AOE, +1.5 Strings +1 Enhancement) a temporary additional Mark (+2 Strings) that lasts for the current Scene (+2 Strings).

Consequence: On a Failure, you are Cursed for the next minute, or until you take a Surge to make a successful Hope Test. (Major Fallout, -2 Strings)

1 Enhancement (2 Strings)

docs.title: Healing Hands
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Strings, 5 Beats

Prerequisite: Healer (-2 Strings)

General Action (4 Strings):

Direct Focus:

Take 1 Stress (-5 Beats) in Instinct to clear the Stress Track (+2 Strings) of an ally within Here. 

Indirect Flipside:

Budget: 1.7 Strings

Add 1 Success (+1 String) to a dying Near (+5 Beats) ally's Countdown, emitting a warm and calming presence from your presence (Aesthetic, +1 Beat).

docs.title: Soothing Presence
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Healing Hands (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Action (2 Strings)

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 2.5 Strings)

On a successful Aura Test (-5 Beats), Heal DV (+1 String) to one ally within Here. 

(General, +2 Strings)

Indirect Focus (Short Rest):

Spend 1 Heart Resistance (-1 Enhancement) to become Spirited (+3 Strings, 1 Enhancement) for the next minute (+2 Strings).

docs.title: Radiant Sacrifice
docs.text:
Cost: 10 Strings 5 Beats (2 Enhancements)

Prerequisite: Divine Barrier

Short Rest Trait:

When an ally within There, you may take a reaction expend a use of your Sequence Die (DV): spending a number (X) of Resistance Points from Heart, and grant the ally twice as many Protection Slots (2*X).

docs.title: Companion (Tether)
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Trait:

You have an animal companion granted to you by your Patron: a pidgeon. Your Tether score represents your bond with this Companion. Companions granted by this Trait are able to contribute in the following ways:

  • Aid: Grant you Advantage on a Test while within Here.

  • Buffer: Once per scene, as a reaction to you being subject to an external effect that applies Stress, you may reduce it by a roll of your chosen Potential's Volatility Die.

  • Connect: The bond between you and your Companion allows you to understand each other even if you do not share a language. You may also use a Surge to perceive through your Companion's senses. While perceiving in this way, you are insensate to your own body's senses.

docs.title: Reap & Sow
docs.text:
Cost: 8 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Control (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus (Spell):

On a successful Grasp Test, target enemy within There (+1 String 5 Beats) becomes Petrified (Major Condition, +3 Strings 1 Enhancement) for this scene (+2 Strings) or until Concentration is broken (-1 String) or the effect is willingly dropped.

Consequence: On a Failure, you are Bound until the end of your next turn (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats).

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 4 Strings) 

Activate this Ability twice to allow 1 ally within Here to regain a Resistance point of their choice (Utility, +1 String).

(General, +1 String)

1 Enhancement (2 Strings)

docs.title: Kidessa’s Kin
docs.text:
Cost: 9 Strings (2 Enhancements)

Prerequisite: Healer/Spirit Golem (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Action (2 Strings)

Direct Focus (Short Rest):

Activate this Action to bestow Close allies (+2 Strings, +1 Enhancement) with the gift of Kidessa’s horns. Affected allies are Empowered (+3 Strings) for 1 minute/Scene (+2 Strings).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 5.5 Strings)

On a successful Hope Test (-0.5), this Action allows 1 ally Here to receive 2HDV (+2 Strings, 1 Enhancement) healing in Nerve. (General, +2 Strings)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Acolyte’s Quarry
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings 9 Beats

Prerequisite: Control | Healer

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus (Spell):

On a successful Grasp Test, blast target enemy within Far (+2 Strings) with a burst of magic from your hands thanks to your Patron. It takes 1TDV damage (+1 String) to Seep.

Consequence: On a Failure, Kidessa becomes displeased that you are using your gifts for violence. You must help another being before your next long rest or face further consequences (Narrative Fallout, -1 Beats).

Indirect Flipside (Spell):

(Budget: 2 Strings 9 Beats) 

On a successful Sway Test, a beam of holy words erupt from your mouth and cause target enemy within There (+1 String 5 Beats) to take 1HDV damage (+1 String) to Tether. This spell cannot be cast if you are silenced or cannot otherwise speak.

Consequence: On a Failure, become Silenced for one round. (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats).

docs.title: Spirit Walk - Surge
docs.text:
Cost: 7 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisites: Control/Inanimate Vessel (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Surge (2 Strings 1 Enhancement)

For a brief time you may step from your corporeal form and manifest as your true self depicted by pure spiritual energy. While you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) during the current Scene (+2 Strings), you are longer affected by the Inanimate Vessel Ability. You are incorporeal, and have Proof against Physical damage and Bane against Mental damage. You can pass through walls, and can make an Anchor Test to interact with physical objects. While in this form (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may activate the effect of an Option Ability generated from this Ability a number of times equal to your Tier*. This activation is a Reaction that must occur on your turn. This gives Options made under this Ability a starting discount of -1 String.

While you are separated from your corporeal form in this way, your physical body becomes inanimate until you return to it. If you lose Concentration before you are able to return to your physical body, you are Bleeding (Instinct) until you receive healing in Instinct. (Major Fallout, -2 Strings)

(^Interpretable*, +5 Strings +1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Hallowed Glare - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 6.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Spirit Walk

Spirit Walk Base (-1 String)

As a part of activating your Spirit Walk Option in this way, you must make a Form Test (-5 Beats). On a success, creatures within Close of you (Close AOE, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) must make an Anchor Test (Test Required, -5 Beats) or become Muddled (I) (Minor Condition AOE, +3 Strings) until the beginning of your next turn. You may spend an Instinct Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to instead inflict the Blinded Condition (Major Condition AOE [instead], +2 Strings +1 Enhancement). Once this effect has been activated, it cannot be activated again until the next Scene (-5 Beats)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Be Not Afraid - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 6.5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Spirit Walk

Spirit Walk Base (-1 String)

Fey, Fiends, and Undead (Narrow Trigger, -1 String) within Close of you (Close AOE, +2 Strings +1 Enhancement) must make an Anchor Test (Test Required, -5 Beats) or take 1TDV damage to Heart (Initial Damage, +1 String) and become Afraid of you (Minor Condition AOE, +3 Strings) until the beginning of your next turn.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Wrath of Small Gods - Spell
docs.text:
Cost: 9.5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Kidessa’s Kin (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus:

Make a Sway Test: on a success, spend a Heart Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) as you call upon the spirits of the area to rise and protect from those who would approach. For the next minute (+2 Strings), any time an adversary starts their turn within Close (+2 Strings +1 Enhancement) of you, you may take a reaction to cause the adversary to take XHDV damage (Initial Damage, +1 String) to Might, where X (Primed and Increased, +1 String +1 Enhancement) is equal to 1 + your Tier (Utility, +1 String).

If you do not spend the Resistance, you may instead only target all adversaries within Close to take the damage once, then the effect ends.

Consequence: You are Rooted (0) until the beginning of your next turn, as the Small Gods of surrounding nature hold you in place, to help you stand sentry against those who would hurt your friends (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 4 Strings 9 Beats)

On a successful Heart (Reflex) Test, a Far (+2 Strings) target becomes Rooted (0) (Minor Condition, +1 String) for the current Scene (+2 Strings).

Consequence: During the next Rest, the Small Gods give you the compulsion to apologize for not stopping that adversary (Narrative Consequence, -1 Beat).

docs.title: Distribution of Judgement
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings

Prerequisite: Spirit Walk/Companion (-2 Strings)

General Action (4 Strings)

Direct Focus:

You are capable of removing parts of your physical body and giving the detached pieces animation and intent. While you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) during the current Scene (+2 Strings), you may remove any part of your body other than your core, which is called an Advocate. Advocates follow your spoken instructions and are given access to the Manipulate Action and default actions. You may increase the number of Advocates you have active by expending a Tether Resistance (-1 String), allowing your Concentration to be tied to all active Advocates instead of just one*.

Losing Concentration on an Advocate or Advocates while they are Here allows you to take a reaction and reattach them to your physical body. If you would lose Concentration while an Advocate is further from you than Here, your Advocate does not reattach to your body (Severe Narrative Consequence, -2 Strings), and becomes inanimate. An inanimate Advocate counts as the material components required to restore a lost body part via the Inanimate Vessel Ability.

(^Interpretable*, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement)

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 2 Strings)

You may order any number of Advocates to assume a single intention. Advocates take their turn immediately after this Action. You may choose to project your senses onto an Advocate within Far range (+2 Strings). Doing so causes you to lose whichever sense you are tuning into in respect to your core and any body parts attached to your core (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String).

(Utility, +1 String)

docs.title: Biblically Accurate Golem - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Distribution of Judgement (-2 Strings)

General Trait (5 Strings 1 Enhancement)

You may create and attach limbs and body parts that otherwise would not match with a typical humanoid form. Doing so requires just as many resources and time required by the limb recovery dictated in Inanimate Vessel (Narrow Trigger, -1 String). Attached body parts (Auxiliaries) are able to interact with the world functionally, giving you an additional Knack called “Biblically Accurate Golem” (Knack, +2 Strings), which applies to any situation where your Auxiliaries are assisting in your action. 

(^Primarily Narrative Ability, -1 String)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Tales of the Dead - Ritual
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Control/Spirit Golem (-2 Strings)

Ritual Spell (0 Strings)

You may communicate with the spirits of the Faerie and Gloam` after meditating as a Rest action. On a successful Grasp Test, you have 1 minute to converse with these spirits (+2 Strings). Spirits under the influence of this spell may only speak truths (Utility, +1 String), and they are Charmed (Minor Condition, +1 String). After every question you ask, the spirits may make a Read Test to remove the Charmed condition (Test Required, -5 Beats). On a success, they are not aware they were Charmed, but you are not aware if they succeed.

Consequence: On a failure, you take 1TDV damage to Tether (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats).

docs.title: Gargoyle Savant - Surge
docs.text:
Cost: 3 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Spirit Walk/Companion (-2 Strings)

Long Rest Surge (1 String 1 Enhancement)

A number of times equal to your Tier* per Long Rest, you may trigger this Surge to spend a Tether Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) and transfer your soul into another roughly figurine-like inanimate object that shares your size category or is smaller. When you activate this Ability, you may choose for your Familiar to activate this Ability instead (Agency, +1 String).

While inhabiting this Gargoyle, you perceive the world around you just as if your Inanimate Vessel were the Gargoyle. This effect lasts while you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) for the next hour (+2 Strings +1 Enhancement). During this time, your Inanimate Vessel is inanimate and considered immune to Mental Stress& and Physically Vulnerable. While the uninhabited Inanimate Vessel takes Physical Stress, keep track of the accumulative Stress in each Physical Potential&: all of which you will receive at one when you reinhabit the Inanimate Vessel (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String).

You are immune to Physical Stress while inhabiting an inanimate Gargoyle&. While inhabiting a Gargoyle, you may make a Desperate Form Test (Test Required, -5 Beats) (Increase Riskiness, -1.5 Strings) to animate the Gargoyle. While in an animate Gargoyle, your Physical Potentials are considered to all be 5, and start with no Stress or Resistances accumulated. You do not keep the Stress or Resistances accumulated in Gargoyle form& when you transfer back to your Inanimate Vessel, however, you keep the same Mark pool despite which vessel you inhabit.

You may take a Surge to transfer your spirit back into your Inanimate Vessel.

(^Interpretable, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement)

(Primarily Narrative Ability, -1 String)

(&: cancel out in mechanical cost)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Spirit Perception - Spell
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Tales of the Dead (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus:

On a successful Weave Test, you psychically assault a Close (+1 String) target creature’s senses. The target takes XTDV damage to Wit (Initial, +1 String) where X (Primed and Increased, +1 String +1 Enhancement) is your Tier (Utility, +1 String).

Consequence: On a failure, you are Muddled (I) for the next minute or until you receive Instinct healing (Major Consequence, -2 Strings).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 2.5 Strings (1 Enhancement))

On a successful Tether (Read) Test, you gain insight into the inner spirit of a target within Here. For the next minute (+2 Strings), you have Advantage (+1 String) on Tests made to glean information about the target’s intentions, identity, and beliefs. They are also Vulnerable (Minor Condition, +1 String) to any of your Spells that would inflict a status Condition (Narrow Trigger, -1 String). You also determine their creature type, their plane of origin, and their alignment (Utility, +1 String)

Consequence: On a failure, the target perceives your attempt to peer into their soul magically, and you have Disadvantage on your next Read Test (Minor Fallout, -5 Beats).

(Primarily Narrative Ability, -1 String)

docs.title: Pact of Chains - Surge
docs.text:
Cost: 7 Strings 1 Beat

Prerequisite: Companion/Control (-2 Strings)

Long Rest Surge (1 String 1 Enhancement)

Presence Base (+5 Strings)

The Familiar assigned to you by your patron has a hidden nature of the eldritch variety. Once per Long Rest, you may take a Surge to make a Risky Grasp Test (Risky Test Required, -1 String) to unleash your Familiar’s physical form from its chains, becoming Unchained (Aesthetic Trigger Marker, +1 Beat). This effect lasts for the current Scene (+2 Strings).

While Unchained, your Familiar has the following Stats:

Name: Dire Wolf

Marks: 3

Potentials:

MIGHT - 5

FINESSE - 3

NERVE - 6

SEEP - 6

INSTINCT - 4

WIT - 4

HEART - 2

TETHER - 5

Consequence: On a failure, your Familiar attempts to break through the bonds of its physical form, and becomes Dispelled until you regain a use of this Ability. (Major Fallout, -2 Strings)

To give your Unchained Familiar (Narrow Trigger, -1 String) Abilities, you may make Option Abilities off of this one (Utility, +1 String).

(Pact of Chains Option Base = -1 String)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Tooth and Claw Option
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings

Prerequisite: Pact of Chains

Pact of Chains Base

Long Rest -> General Action (3 Strings)

Surge -> Action (-1 Enhancement)

Direct Focus:

Either you, your Familiar, or both you and your Familiar may activate this Ability (Presence, +1 Enhancement), though your Familiar can only activate the Ability while Unchained (Narrow Trigger, -1 String).

You make an unarmed attack. On a successful Force Test, you deal 1SDV damage (Initial, +1 String) to Might. In addition, you cause the target to become Held (Minor Condition, +1 String) until they take a Surge to make a successful Squirm Test to escape.

Indirect Flipside:

(Budget: 2 Strings)

Move Close (+1 String). On a successful Grace Test (Test Required, -5 Beats), your Familiar becomes Obscured* until the end of its next turn. While Obscured, a Familiar is considered to be Unseen (Minor Condition, +1 String) by a target creature within Near (5 Beats). 

(*Aesthetic, +1 Beat)

Consequence: On a failure, the target sees your Familiar before it can Obscure itself, and knows that this is no ordinary animal (Narrative Fallout, -1 Beat).

docs.title: Healing Tale
docs.text:
Cost: 4 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Healing Hands | Soothesong (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 2 Strings)

On a successful Hope Test, heal one target ally within Close (+1 String) 1HDV (Initial Healing, +1 String) in Nerve.

Consequence: Your voice cracks each time you fail this Ability’s Hope Test. After failing a number of times equal to your Tier before you take a Short Rest, you cannot activate this Ability until you take a Short Rest (Narrative Fallout, -1 Beat).

Indirect Focus [Flavor Required, -1 String]:

Spell -> Short Rest (-1 String)

Represent a story through an artistic medium or historical mythos: choose a Potential (P) (Utility, +1 String) encapsulated by the agents in the story. Any ally, including yourself, (AOE GM ruling, +2 String +1 Enhancement) that is paying close attention to your performance may receive 1HDV (Initial Healing, +1 String) healing to the chosen Potential (P).

(*Narrative Consequence, -1 String)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Follow the Holy Path
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Healer/Control/Shaman (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Trait (3 Strings 1 Enhancement)

When a Close ally that you can see would be subject to a source of damage originating from Here of them (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may take a reaction to teleport (Utility, +1 String) them to a space within Close of you. The target then is given 1HDV of healing in Nerve.

(*Close Range, +1 String)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Salve - Perk
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Beats

Prerequisite: Soothing Presence

When this Perk activates on a Test that would heal an ally, they receive additional healing equal to the value this Perk is assigned to.

docs.title: Soothe - Perk
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Beats

Prerequisite: Soothing Presence

When this Perk activates on a Healer Spell Test that results in an overall Failure or Miff, consider the Consequence of this Spell as having one Duration level lower than defined (e.g. Hour -> Minute, Minute -> Turn).

docs.title: Upgrade - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Control | Healer

Upgrade Base (4 Strings)

You gain an increase to your Stored Spell Limit (+2 String) equal to your Tier (Utility, +1 String). However, once per Long Rest, if one of your patrons deems it necessary, they may swap one of your chosen Prepared Spells for one of your Unprepared Spells (Severe Narrative Consequence, -2 Strings).

docs.title: Child of the Dreaming - Bloodline Trait
docs.text:
Budget Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Wevnajen (-2 Strings)

General Trait (5 Strings 1 Enhancement): 

Wevnajen come from several long lines of descendants who share an ancestral spirit which is passed down to a particular child of a family. These spirits may choose their successors in many different ways, whether it be the youngest child, the women of a family, or even the fated odd-one-out. These spirits come from The Dreaming, a immaterial plane of emotion and ephemeralness, where force of presence determines a soul's interactions within the plane. Wevnajen are able to commune with their ancestral spirit and inherit an innate affinity for psionic power. This allows Wevnajen to drift between the minds of others, providing nonverbal communication and mental influence.

  • You do not have dreams, and instead see the memories of ancestors past while you sleep.

  • You can talk telepathically to creatures who would normally be within earshot, and they may respond in the same manner. You may choose to keep this conversation private, or open up your connection to a group of creatures. You may also convey images through this connection to willing creatures in the form of visions. When targeting an unwilling creature, you must make an Anchor Test (Test, -5 Beats) to successfully Enrapture (Minor Condition, +1 String) them until the end of your next turn.

  • Once per Long Rest, you may walk alongside willing allies in a shared dream, either one of their own or one of your ancestral spirit's.

  • Your emotions are more visible that that of a typical humanoid's. Shifts in your mood are depicted in a visual manner on your body, whether that be a faint glowing effect, a change in eye color, or hair that appears constantly moving as if suspended, changing its rhythm or movement in response to your emotions. (Narrative Consequence, -5 Beats)

(^Narrative Weight: Utility, 1 String)

(Primarily narrative, -1 String)

1 Enhancement (2 Strings)

docs.title: Companion - Gloamlynx - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: N/A

You have access to a shadowbeast companion, which can be summoned using a ritual. Your Instinct Potential represents your bond with the Gloamlynx. Companions granted by this Trait are able to contribute in the following ways:

  • Aid: Grant you Advantage ok a Test while within Here. 

  • Buffer: Once per scene, as a reaction to you being subject to an external effect that applies Stress, you may reduce it by a roll of your chosen Potential's Volatility Die. 

  • Connect: The bond between you and your Companion allows you to understand each other even if you do not share a language. You may also use a Surge to perceive through your Companion's senses. While perceiving in this way, you are insensate to your own body's senses.

docs.title: Presence - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Gloamlynx

docs.title: Mal - Gloamlynx
docs.text:
Marks: 4

MIGHT: 6

FINESSE: 2

NERVE: 5

SEEP: 6

INSTINCT: 4

WIT: 1

HEART: 1

TETHER: 2

Mal has his own set of Volatility Dice that you must keep track of, all of which start at D4s. When you level up, you may apply chosen Stat bonuses to your Companion instead.

docs.title: Specialization - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Prerequisite: Companion

Skills: Grace, Force

Knack: Scary Dog Privilege

docs.title: Knots Pool - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings

Prerequisite: Wevnajen/Saboteur

You have a number of Knot Points (a special kind of Instinct Resistance) equal to your level in Saboteur (11). You may create Abilities that expend Knots instead of Resistances, but still have the discount to the cost of spending a Resistance (-1 String) and having a prerequisite (-2 Strings). Your number of Knots is considered a permanent Stat.

docs.title: Coordination - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Prerequisite: Companion/Knots Pool

Mal has access to your Knots Pool and shares its usages.

docs.title: Driven - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 6 Strings 1 Beats (1 Enhancement)

Driven Base (1 String (1 Enhancement))

Hot-Headed (Flaw, +2 Strings): You are aggressive in your social interactions, and are prone to taking the more direct route rather than the socially acceptable one. This includes blurting out hidden insights for your benefit, using force before persuasion, frightening others into complacency, and lashing out emotionally when under stress.

Toxicologist (Minor Goal, +1 String +1 Beat): Whenever you learn or discover the recipe to a new non-magical distilled substance, called a Concoction (Aesthetic, +1 Beat), you gain 1 String.

Harvester (Flavor Goal, -4 Beats): After you have discovered the recipe to a specific Concoction (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may describe how you obtain the ingredients for said Concoction (Aesthetic, +1 Beat) to gain 1 Flavor Token.

Scattered Epiphany (Minor Goal, +1 String +1 Beat): Whenever you glean insight into another person’s emotional patterns or habits, confront them for it, and roleplay your way into realizing it is a reflection of yourself in some way and resolve that Retrospection (Aesthetic, +1 Beat), you may gain 1 String.

I’ve Done My Time (Flavor Goal, +5 Beats): Whenever you step aside in a moment of climax to allow another party member to shine, and describe how you complement their narrative, you may receive a Flavor Token.

docs.title: Facets of Id - Surge
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Child of the Dreaming/Saboteur (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Surge (2 Strings, 1 Enhancement):

You gain psionic benefits based on your current primary emotion. You may make Option Abilities based off of this Parent Ability*. Activating each option requires expending a use of this Ability, which lasts for the current Scene (+2 Strings).

Activating a Facet of Id requires you to either currently be under the influence of the corresponding emotion (Narrow Trigger -1 String OR..), OR to make a Grasp Test to force yourself into an Emotional Frenzy while this Ability is active. While in an Emotional Frenzy, you are inclined to make decisions based around the chosen emotion (..OR Test Required -5 Beats, Narrative Consequence -5 Beats). 

(Option Base = -1 String)

When you explode a Volatility Die (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may spend an Instinct Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to activate it whether it has been expended already or not, purchasing from the Experience Market a new effect for your current emotion, as long as it is a unique one. When purchasing in this way, your budget for creating new effects is considered to have an additional -1 String discount.

(^Interpretable +3 Strings, 1 Enhancement)

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Rage - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Facets of Id

Facet of Id Base (-1 String)

You may add an additional Volatility Die to Tests rolled to make an attack against a creature (Temporary Proficiency, +1 String). On a success, you may add an additional 1TDV to Heart to the damage (Initial Damage +1 String).

docs.title: Arrogance - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String 5 Beats

Prerequisite: Facets of Id

Facet of Id Base (-1 String)

You may replace any of your Attack actions with the following Spell (+1 String): On a successful Instinct (Weave) Test, infiltrate the mind of one Close (+1 String) creature, causing it to, while this Ability is active, become Afraid (+1 String).

Consequence: On a failed Test, you become Distracted (-5 Beats) by that creature until the end of your next turn.

docs.title: Fear - Option
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String

Prerequisite: Facets of Id

Facet of Id Base (-1 String)

You may spend a Finesse Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to become Invisible (Major Condition, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement) while you maintain Concentration (-1 String).

docs.title: Calculated Strike - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 8 Strings (2 Enhancements)

Prerequisite: Saboteur (-2 Strings)

General Trait (5 Strings 1 Enhancement)

Once per round, when you roll a Test to make a weapon attack against a single target and the Test is not considered Risky, Dire, or Desperate or having Disadvantage*, you may add the sum of up to X dice from your Volatility Pool (Utility, +1 String) to the damage (Prime + Increase, +1 String +1 Enhancement) of the attack, where X is your Tier.

(*Narrow Triggers, -2 Strings)

1st Enhancement (+2 Strings)

2nd Enhancement (+3 Strings)

docs.title: Toxins & Oils
docs.text:
Cost: 1.5 Strings

Prerequisite: Driven/Saboteur (-2 Strings)

Conditional Action (5 Beats)

Direct Flipside:

(Budget: 7 Beats)

You may take spend 1 hour or a Rest Action to expend a use of this Ability and produce a Concoction that can either coat a weapon or 10 pieces of ammunition with a toxin or oil, imbue a consumable with a poison, or be thrown as a bottled aerosol. Your dutiful preparation grants you a +1 to your success level when making a Test to distill this Concoction (+5 Beats). A Crit on this Test allows you to choose to spend a Wit Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to make 2 Concoction doses instead of 1. You may spend 1 Flavor Token to gain 1 use of this ability.

You may make Concoctions as Options under this Parent Ability*. Instead of inheriting the base Activation Profile, use the trigger described in the Indirect side of this Ability. Activating a Concoction expends the prepared Concoction (Material Components, -1 String) and must be one of 4 types: Toxin, Aerosol, Oil, or Poison, which can only be activated in their respective manners (Narrow Trigger, -1 String):

  • Creating a Toxin or Aerosol Ability is considered to require a Test from the target to resist the effects (-5 Beats). (Toxin/Aerosol Base Cost = -2.5 Strings)

  • Creating an Oil Ability is considered to have a Consequence as it chemically reacts to you as you apply it to a weapon (-X for Fallout). (Oil Base Cost = -2 - X Strings)

  • Creating a Poison Ability is considered to only be activated once consumed, their effects have a 1-minute delay (-2 Strings), and do not need a Test to apply effects (+5 Beats). (Poison Base Cost = -3.5 Strings)

(*Interpretable, +3 Strings +1 Enhancement)

Conditional Ritual (-3 Strings)

Indirect Focus:

Expend a use of this Action to apply, administer, or otherwise activate the effect of a Concoction you have prepared (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), which lasts for the next hour (+2 Strings +1 Enhancement).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Corpseflower Dust - Option (Aerosol)
docs.text:
Cost: 4.5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Aerosol Base (-2.5 Strings)

When activated, you may expend this aerosol and its bottle by throwing it within Close (+1 String) range to create a cloud of dust particulate within Near of the point of impact (Near AOE, +2 Strings 1 Enhancement), making any creature inside the cloud Unseen (+1 String) but also Blinded (Major Fallout, -2 Strings). Adversaries inside or entering this space for the first time must make a Form Test or be Muddled in Nerve (Minor Condition, +3 Strings).

1 Enhancement (2 Strings)

docs.title: Ghoul's Blood - Option (Oil)
docs.text:
Cost: 2 Strings

Oil Base (-4 Strings) [Major Fallout]

When activated, you may expend this oil by coating your blade or ammunition with a bare hand, activating the oil's chemical reaction. While active, you and your weapon buzz with bloodlust, and you have Advantage (+1 String) on any attacks made with this weapon, but you are considered Distracted (^Major Fallout) when making any other Tests for the duration. During this time, you may expend one Seep Resistance (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to become Frenzied (Major Condition, +3 Strings 1 Enhancement) for the duration. Becoming Frenzied also allows you to clear your Finesse Stress Track (+2 Strings).

docs.title: Truth Serum - Option (Poison)
docs.text:
Cost: 1.5 Strings

Poison Base (-3.5 Strings)

You may pour the contents of this bottle into a drink or dish, imbuing it with following effects should a creature consume it: after 1 minute, the consumer is compelled to only communicate what they believe is the truth (Utility, +1 String) for the next hour (1 Enhancement). During this time, you have the Instigative Interrogator, granting you Advantage on Tests made to discern intent or conviction behind this creature's actions and words and deciphering the space between truth and disclosure (Knack, +2 Strings).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

docs.title: Fleetfooted
docs.text:
Cost: 9 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Coordination/Saboteur (-2 Strings)

General Action (4 Strings)

Direct Focus

Move There (+2 Strings) and become Warded (1) (Major Condition, +3 Strings 1 Enhancement) until the end of your next turn. You may spend a Knot (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to make this action Synchronized (+1 Enhancement).

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside

(Budget: 4.5 Strings)

Move Close (+1 String) and make a Risky (-5 Beats) weapon attack (+1 String). When you take this action, you may swap the order of its movement and weapon attack (Utility, +1 String). Your Companion has Agency with this action (+1 String).

(^Movement + Attack, +1 String)

docs.title: Shadowstep
docs.text:
Cost: 11 Strings (3 Enhancements)

Prerequisite: Fleetfooted (-2 Strings)

Short Rest Action (2 Strings)

Direct Flipside (Sense Spell, +1 String)

(Budget: 5.5 Strings)

If you are Invisible (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may make a Sense Test to remove your Invisible condition (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String) to send dark bolts of energy at 1+X targets within Far (+2 Strings) range, X being the number of Knots you spend (+- Enhancement) with this ability. Each target is Blinded (+3 Strings, 1 Enhancement) while you Concentrate during this scene (+2 Strings, -1 Enhancement).

Minor Consequence (-5 Beats): On a failed Sense Test, become Muddled (W) until the end of your next turn.

Indirect Focus (Short Rest, TetherDV)

Set out a Sequence Die equal to your Tether Volatility (+2 Strings, 1 Enhancement). While you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement), you may expend a use of the Sequence Die any time you Move to activate the following action:

This Action is Synchronized (+1 Enhancement). If your starting and ending points of this movement are in shadow (Narrow Trigger, -1 String), you may instead teleport (Utility, +1 String). If you teleport, become Invisible (+3 Strings, 1 Enhancement) until you deal damage or a condition to another creature (Mechanical Consequence, -1 String), or until this Scene ends (+2 Strings).

1st Enhancement (+2 Strings)

2nd Enhancement (+3 Strings)

docs.title: One with Shadow - Spell
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Companion/Saboteur (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus (Spell) (Agency, +1 String)

On an Instinct (Grace) Test, spend a Knot (Amplified, -1 Enhancement) to become Invisible (+3 Strings, 1 Enhancement) while you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) or Until Dispelled (2 Enhancements).

Major Consequence (-2 Strings): On a failed Grace Test, become Blinded until the end of your next turn.

1 Enhancement (+2 Strings)

Indirect Flipside (Read Spell)

(Budget: 2.5 Strings)

While you Concentrate (-1 String) during the current Scene (+2 Strings), you have Advantage (+1 String) on attacks against a target Close (+1 String) creature.

Minor Consequence (-5 Beats): You are Vulnerable in Instinct until the end of your next turn.

docs.title: Psionic Fortitude - Stat
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Wevnajen (-2 Strings)

Upgrade Base (4 Strings)

You have Proof (+3 Strings) against damage coming from sources of Psionics and madness.

docs.title: Dexterity - Trait
docs.text:
Cost: 1 String (1 Enhancement)

Prerequisite: Saboteur

The Dexterity Ability allows a character to use their Finesse Potential instead of their Might Potential when making Tests with melee weapons. This does not apply to any weapon with the Heavy or Unwieldy properties.

docs.title: Hailfire - Spell
docs.text:
Cost: 5 Strings

Prerequisite: Calculated Strike (-2 Strings)

Spell Action (3 Strings)

Direct Focus (Spell):

On a successful Instinct (Sleight) Test, while you Concentrate (-1 Enhancement) on this spell or until this Scene ends (+2 Strings), you may activate the following effect as a reaction the next time you successfully make a ranged attack against a target: creatures within Near, including the target (+2 Strings, 1 Enhancement) are barraged by a spray of splinters and thorns, dealing 1DV (Initial Damage, +1 String) to Might.
